capabilities: Chat with an AI agent about your vault
Create custom slash-command skills from markdown prompt files
Generate notes, summaries, and .canvas files from requests
Search the web and access files outside the vault
Switch between Claude Code and Antigravity agents with safety modes
disambiguation: Not just a chat sidebar or writing assistant; it is an agent that controls the Obsidian UI, runs commands, and acts outside the vault.
extras: Desktop-only (no mobile support). Usage details for Skills, session management, and settings are in an external User Guide linked from the README. The plugin is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README says it aims to 'turn Obsidian into a tool that reaches beyond PKM, notetaking, storage, and organization', letting users extend Obsidian conversationally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to delegate vault tasks — summarizing, renaming, researching, building skills — to an AI agent with real access to notes, commands, and files.

relations.evidence: Claude, through the Claude Code CLI — included in Claude Pro/Max subscriptions.
Gemini, through Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) — needs a Google account with Antigravity access.

requires.name: Claude Code CLI or Google Antigravity CLI
Claude Pro/Max subscription or Google account with Antigravity access

summary: AI agent platform that connects Obsidian to the Claude Code or Antigravity CLI so you can operate your vault through conversation.
